text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Oho! So your birthday present for me is a 
'treasure hunt'!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
That said... all I really did was hide a 
few toys around the academy, though...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! Based on various adventure tales, I 
made a treasure-hunting story and map... 
...Th-That's childish stuff, isn't it—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Rob Roy! You are seriously, 
reeeeally awesome!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
How'd you know my absolute favorite 
thing!? I'm so hyped! Let's go look for it 
right away!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah... well, this notebook contains hints 
for finding the treasure, so—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
No! Never mind the notes! Could you show 
me around instead?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Every adventure story needs a chronicler, 
right? Rob Roy, I want to set out on a 
journey with you! You'll come with me, 
won't you!?
